我们注意到一些舰队指挥官和领袖之间的分歧和争论有所增加。如果[admiral_democracy.GetName]认为我们应该干点什么，可以肯定[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]将对着干。

起初，这似乎只是对手之间的良性竞争，但最近气氛变得越来越令人不快，充满火药味，我们看到他们的同僚也开始站队了。
excerpt.en: We have seen a rise in disagreements and arguing between some of our commanders and leaders. If [admiral_democracy.GetName] thinks we should go through with something, you can be sure that [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] will argue that we should do the opposite.

texts.zh:
我们注意到一些舰队指挥官和领袖之间的分歧和争论有所增加。如果[admiral_democracy.GetName]认为我们应该干点什么，可以肯定[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]将对着干。

起初，这似乎只是对手之间的良性竞争，但最近气氛变得越来越令人不快，充满火药味，我们看到他们的同僚也开始站队了。
texts.en:
We have seen a rise in disagreements and arguing between some of our commanders and leaders. If [admiral_democracy.GetName] thinks we should go through with something, you can be sure that [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] will argue that we should do the opposite.

At first it seemed to only be a good-natured rivalry between equals, but lately it has become ever more toxic and hostile, and we are starting to see their peers taking sides as well.

label.zh: 无论如何，我们都要结束这场争吵。
label.en: We will end this bickering, one way or another.

label.zh: 他们迟早能解决的。
label.en: They will figure it out, in time.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位寡头的称呼。
note.en: In the game, the title of this oligarch appears here.

texts.zh:
这不再是一个简单的意见不一致的问题，因为整个海军司令部已经达到了彼此彻底敌对的地步。两名指挥官最初的争执，现在已经把整个办公室一分为二，再也没有人试图在他们之间斡旋和平。

除了司令部的分裂，他们现在也分裂成两个明确界定的政治团体，一个支持我们目前的民主领导，另一个认为司令部应该在我们的政府中发挥更大的政治作用。
texts.en:
No longer is it a simple case of disagreeing, as the whole admiralty have reached a point of outright hostility to one another. What was at first two commanders arguing has now split the whole office in two, and there is no longer anyone trying to broker peace between them.

In addition to splitting the admiralty, they have now also split into two clearly defined political groups, one supporting our current democratic leadership, and one that thinks the admiralty should have a stronger political role in our government.

texts.zh:
这不再是一个简单的意见不一致的问题，因为整个海军司令部已经达到了彼此彻底敌对的地步。两名指挥官最初的争执，现在已经把整个办公室一分为二，再也没有人试图在他们之间斡旋和平。

除了司令部的分裂，他们现在也分裂成两个明确界定的政治团体，一个支持我们目前的领导层，另一个认为大众应该在我们的政府中发挥更大的政治作用。
texts.en:
No longer is it a simple case of disagreeing, as the whole admiralty have reached a point of outright hostility to one another. What at first were two commanders arguing has now split the whole office in two, and there is no longer anyone trying to broker peace between them.

In addition to splitting the admiralty, they have now also split into two clearly defined political groups, one supporting our current leadership, and one that thinks the general populace should have a larger role to play in our government.

texts.zh:
这不再是一个简单的意见不一致的问题，因为整个海军司令部已经达到了彼此彻底敌对的地步。两名指挥官最初的争执，现在已经把整个办公室一分为二，再也没有人试图在他们之间斡旋和平。

除了司令部的分裂，他们现在也分裂成两个明确界定的政治团体，一个认为司令部应该在我们的政府中发挥重要作用，另一个认为大众应该被赋予更多的政治权力。
texts.en:
No longer is it a simple case of disagreeing, as the whole admiralty have reached a point of outright hostility to one another. What at first were two commanders arguing has now split the whole office in two, and there is no longer anyone trying to broker peace between them.

In addition to splitting the admiralty, they have now also split into two clearly defined political groups, one who believes the admiralty should play a strong role in our government, and one that thinks the general populace should be given more political power.

label.zh: 他们要继续这种愚蠢的行为多久？
label.en: How long will they keep this nonsense going?

texts.zh:
我们收到消息，我们的附庸，[subject_empire.GetName]，现在似乎正在进行一场内部斗争，他们的海军司令部在两名指挥官卷入冲突后陷入混乱。

他们的领导层忙于控制事态，而由于两个敌对指挥官的支持者们仍在持续争夺权力，我们怀疑他们还能不能成为我们可靠的盟友和附庸。
texts.en:
We have received news that our vassal, [subject_empire.GetName], seems to have an internal struggle going on right now, with their admiralty in shambles after two commanders have ended up embroiled in a conflict.

With their leadership scrambling to get everything under control, we are unsure how reliable an ally and vassal they can be, as the two sides backing the rival commanders are continuously vying for power.

label.zh: 让我们在事态变糟之前介入吧。
label.en: Let us step in before it gets worse.

label.zh: 处理他们的内部事务不是我们分内的事。
label.en: It's not our job to fix their internal affairs.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现附庸帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the vassal empire appears here.

texts.zh: 当来自[overlord_empire.GetName]的外交官抵达并帮助调停事态时，我们曾对[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]和[admiral_democracy]达成妥协寄予厚望。但经过几天的持续争吵，似乎双方唯一达成共识的是，我们的宗主国在他们的争端中起不到任何作用。
texts.en: We had high hopes that the problems between [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] and [admiral_democracy] would finally come to an end, when diplomats from [overlord_empire.GetName] arrived to help broker peace in the conflict. But after days of continuous bickering, it seems the only thing the two sides have agreed upon is that our overlord has no part to play in their disputes.

label.zh: 连他们也帮不上吗？
label.en: Not even they could help?

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位民主派领袖的称呼。
note.en: In the game, the title of this democratic leader appears here.

note.en: In the game, the title of this oligarch appears here.

texts.zh:
司令部双方之间的冲突已经持续了数周甚至数月，其中一方由[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]领导的，另一个由[admiral_democracy.GetName]领导，此前也还未发生任何直接的暴力事件，但现在却发现了一名民主支持者的尸体。

虽然我们没有发现任何证据表明另一方参与了这起谋杀，但这必将引发双方更激烈、更暴力的反应。
texts.en:
It has been weeks and months of the conflict between the two sides of the admiralty, one led by [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] and the other led by [admiral_democracy.GetName], and yet there has not been any outright violence. Until now - with the discovery of the body of one of the democratic supporters.

Though we have found no proof that the other side is involved in the suspected murder, this is sure to spark even harsher and more violent responses from the two sides moving forward.

label.zh: 我们可以做些什么来挽救这种局面呢？
label.en: What can be done to salvage this situation?

texts.zh:
我们收到一份报告，一艘身份不明的货船在[crash_planet.GetName]的居民区坠毁。在我们正寻找能做些什么来帮助他们时，所有曾经住在那里的人都暂时被转移到避难所。

寡头团体不仅主张无视那些被赶出家园的人的困境，而且主张在该地区开发一个新的矿产，因为这艘货船似乎发现了一个我们以前从未见过的完整的富矿脉。当然，他们的对手强烈反对这个想法，并要求我们把精力集中在重建受灾群众的家园上。
texts.en:
A report has come back to us, that an unidentified cargo ship has crashed into a residential area on [crash_planet.GetName]. All who used to live there have temporarily been moved into shelters, while we are seeing what we can do to help.

The oligarchic group has advocated for not only ignoring the plight of those evicted from their homes, but to open up a new mineral mine in the district, as it seems the cargo ship found a whole rich vein that we have not seen before now. Their rivals, of course, deeply oppose the idea, and demand that we focus our efforts on rebuilding the homes of those affected.

label.zh: 我们将重建他们的家园。
label.en: And rebuild their homes we shall.

tooltips.zh: 司令部的民主派将获得更大的影响力。
tooltips.en: The democratic faction of the admiralty will gain more influence.

label.zh: 说到矿物我可就不困了。
label.en: Minerals, you say?

tooltips.zh: 司令部的寡头派系将获得更大的影响力。
tooltips.en: The oligarchic faction of the admiralty will gain more influence.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们不仅看到这场冲突正在司令部上演，甚至还波及到了整个帝国。尽管大多数暴力事件都没有公开，但双方在这一点上都蒙受了重大损失。

我们在两边的线人告诉我们，双方都在盯着国家的领导权，并计划武力夺权以彻底除掉对手。在这个时间点上，似乎我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]也不得不站队一方，否则就会被另一方扳倒。
texts.en:
We have seen the conflict play out not only in the admiralty itself, but all across our empire as well. Though most of the violence have been kept out of the public eye, both sides have seen significant losses at this point.

Our informants on both sides have informed us that both are now eyeing the leadership of the nation itself, and are planning to take it by force so they can get rid of their opponents. It seems at this point even our [Root.GetRulerTitle] will have to take a side, or else face removal by the other.

label.zh: [admiral_democracy.GetName]的民粹主义运动。
label.en: The populist movement of [admiral_democracy.GetName].

tooltips.zh: 司令部的民主派将获得显著更大的影响力。
tooltips.en: The democratic faction of the admiralty will gain significantly more influence.

label.zh: [admiral_oligarchy.GetName]的军事领导权。
label.en: The military leadership of [admiral_oligarchy.GetName].

tooltips.zh: 司令部的寡头派系将获得显著更大的影响力。
tooltips.en: The oligarchic faction of the admiralty will gain significantly more influence.

note.en: The game shows the ruler's title for your government.

note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位寡头的称呼。
note.en: In the game, the title of this oligarch appears here.

label.zh: 希望最坏的情况已经过去。
label.en: Let us hope the worst is over with.

texts.zh: 似乎我们的附庸，[subject_empire.GetName]的司令部有许多分歧和冲突，导致他们的帝国分裂为两部分。虽然冲突仍然激烈，但双方似乎都接受了我们的继续统治。
texts.en: It seems the many disagreements and conflicts in the admiralty of our vassal, the [subject_empire.GetName], have led to their empire splitting in two parts. Though still in heated conflict, both sides seem to accept our continued rule.

label.zh: 至少我们不用再听这种事了。
label.en: At least we will not have to hear more about it.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现附庸帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the vassal empire appears here.

texts.zh: 如今，这种争论和冲突已不再局限于司令部，我们在帝国的每个部门都能看到。最近的事件涉及到因民事需要而划拨给[Root.Capital.GetName]的资金，寡头们想要把它们重新分配给军队。
texts.en: Now no longer contained simply to the admiralty, we see the arguments and conflicts in every office across our empire. The latest incident involves funds earmarked for civil needs on [Root.Capital.GetName], which the oligarchs want to re-allocate for the military.

label.zh: 原先的划拨是有原因的。
label.en: It was earmarked for a reason.

tooltips.zh: 司令部的民主派将获得更大的影响力。
tooltips.en: The democratic faction of the admiralty will gain more influence.

label.zh: 寡头们是对的，把资金转移给军队。
label.en: The oligarchs are right, move the funding to the military.

tooltips.zh: 司令部的寡头派系将获得更大的影响力。
tooltips.en: The oligarchic faction of the admiralty will gain more influence.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
在寡头派办公室附近发生了一场特别残酷的抗议之后，这两个派系的一些成员都受到了质疑。不出所料，双方的故事都截然不同，大多都将一切归咎于对手。

他们不仅希望我们选择一方，而且双方都愿意介入以确保我们投入的时间是值得的。
texts.en:
After a particularly violent protest close to the offices of the oligarchic faction, several members of both factions have been brought into question. As expected, both sides have incredibly different stories, mostly blaming their rivals for everything that went down.

Not only do they want us to choose a side, but both sides are willing to step in and make sure that it is worth our time.

label.zh: 民粹主义者有这个权利。
label.en: The populists have the right of it.

tooltips.zh: 司令部的民主派将获得更大的影响力。
tooltips.en: The democratic faction of the admiralty will gain more influence.

label.zh: 显然，寡头们在这次袭击中是无辜的。
label.en: Clearly, the oligarchs were innocent in this attack.

tooltips.zh: 司令部的寡头派系将获得更大的影响力。
tooltips.en: The oligarchic faction of the admiralty will gain more influence.

texts.zh: 我们收到了一份报告，提到一个亲密盟友[admiral_democracy.GetName]挪动公共资金用于不光彩的个人支出。许多人声称这可能是代其派系行事。如果公众知道这场运动挪用了公共资金为私人服务，那肯定会给他们的民粹主义议程泼冷水。
texts.en: A report has been brought back to us, about the scandalous personal spending of public funds by a close ally of [admiral_democracy.GetName]. Many claim it might have been on behalf of their faction. If the public were to learn this movement has used public funds for themselves, it would surely put a damper on their populist agenda.

label.zh: 我们会保护他们，就这一次。
label.en: We will protect them, just this once.

label.zh: 一个值得分享的丑闻。
label.en: A scandal worth sharing.

tooltips.zh: 司令部的寡头派系将获得更大的影响力。
tooltips.en: The oligarchic faction of the admiralty will gain more influence.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

texts.zh:
经过漫长的调查，他们似乎终于找到了司令部办公室第一起谋杀案的凶手。所有的证据都指向了[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]最亲密的顾问之一，他私自下令暗杀了他们的对手。

虽然[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]没有做错任何事，但如果公众知道了，会对其运动造成不良影响。
texts.en:
After a long-winded investigation, it seems they have finally found the perpetrator of the first murder in the admiralty offices. All evidence points to one of the closest advisors to [admiral_oligarchy.GetName], who personally ordered the assassination of their opponent.

Though [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] is innocent of any wrong-doing, it would reflect poorly on their movement if the public were to know about it.

label.zh: 我们保证他们不会知道的。
label.en: We will make sure they won't know.

label.zh: 所以凶手终于被找到了。
label.en: So the murderer has finally been found then.

tooltips.zh: 司令部的民主派将获得更大的影响力。
tooltips.en: The democratic faction of the admiralty will gain more influence.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位寡头的称呼。
note.en: In the game, the title of this oligarch appears here.

texts.zh: 因为我们担心司令部的冲突会蔓延到我们帝国的其他领导层，我们的盟友[overlord_empire.GetName]介入并设法平息了事态。看起来[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]或[admiral_democracy.GetName]都不愿意反对[overlord_empire.Capital.GetName]的领导层。
texts.en: As we feared the conflicts in the admiralty would spread to the rest of the leadership of our empire, our ally [overlord_empire.GetName] stepped in and managed to calm things. It seems not even [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] or [admiral_democracy.GetName] are willing to oppose the leadership in [overlord_empire.Capital.GetName].

label.zh: 争论终于结束了。
label.en: Finally, an end to the arguments.

# 争吵的指挥官 / The Bickering Commanders

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/overlord_subject_events.txt:1465-2470`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:521-535,4793-4799`；`common/scripted_effects/overlord_effects.txt:1-60`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 宗主国每五年一次的随机脉冲 on_five_year_random_pulse_overlord（00_on_actions.txt:521-535）：无事200，11个事件链各10（subject.1、50、100、1001、1050、1100、2001、2050、2100、3001、3050）；每条链的隐藏派发事件检查冷却标志和条件。
  The overlord's five-year random pulse on_five_year_random_pulse_overlord (00_on_actions.txt:521-535): nothing 200, eleven chains at 10 each (subject.1, 50, 100, 1001, 1050, 1100, 2001, 2050, 2100, 3001, 3050); the hidden dispatcher of each chain checks cooldown flags and conditions.
- 派发 subject.1100（隐藏）：宗主国有堡垒型、非格式塔、非和平主义、民主或寡头制的附庸，且附庸至少有两名指挥官；冷却标志 cooldown_bulwark_event_chain_6_*。
  Hidden dispatcher subject.1100: an overlord with a Bulwark, non-gestalt, non-pacifist democratic or oligarchic subject that has at least two commanders; cooldown flags cooldown_bulwark_event_chain_6_*.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 1102「争吵的指挥官」（附庸）：a 结束争吵 → 150天后 25%（经修正）1105「分裂的海军部」，b 放任 → 90% 1105 / 10% 1110「宗主国介入」。
  1102 "The Bickering Commanders" (subject): a end the bickering -> 150 days later 25% (modified) 1105 "A Split Admiralty", b let it be -> 90% 1105 / 10% 1110 "Overlord Intervened".
- 1105 → 150天后（宗主国）1107：a 介入 → 75% 1110（结束）/25% 1112「宗主国干扰」→ 150天后 1115；b 不介入 → 1115「杀意」。
